-Looking a labs sent from early this month, lipids done was calculated as opposed to direct LDL. 
Insurance companies look for the direct 101 when approving medications because this is a more 
accurate count, therefore, representing a more accurate cardiovascular risk equivalent. When the

Re: New Canaan modem homes conversation.... 
Hi Lesley. Good to see you yesterday. I wasted - uh I mean I spent an hour and 
a half with Jeff! 
In Germany in the 1920's there was a modernist architecture and design group 
called the Bauhaus movement. This was the beginning of modernism as we know it 
now. The leaders of the movement, all feared hitler and naziism, which tries to 
stamp out the movement as being radical and anti German. So, In 1929 several fled 
to the US. Harvard took in i think around 8 of these bauhaus architects as 
professors. 
There was much interest and excitement about their work and they started to get 
commissions to design homes near Cambridge. 
New Canaan become their 
"laboratory" due to a few early commissions from residents eager to build a new 
modern home. 
Then in the SO's an American architect, Phillip Johnson designed a 
glass house for his residence. This house is iconic for its 100% glass. Also 
very innovative and ground breaking. Google Phillip Johnson glass house. Some of 
the moderns of new Canaan haven't been kept up but many are still amazing. The 
design movement coined it international modernism and is known for the flat roofs 
and horizontal orientation. These architects also designed many iconic modern 
furniture pieces. 
Some of the architects were: walter Gropius, marcel Bruer, 
and others from the bauhaus school. 
My best, terry

Atlantic State Consultants is a representative advisor, as an extension of the owner. Ensuring 
the successful completion of a significant building project requires comprehensive project 
oversight. Our construction management advisor team assumes that burden for its clients, 
serving as your Representative. In this role, Atlantic State brings architects, consultants, 
contractors, and planners together as a team under one central point of accountability. 
Atlantic State Consultants offers a full spectrum of Owner's Representative services: 
. Pre-Construction: ASC will help determine, with the Owners consultants, which permits and 
approvals are required, meet building officials and other authorities with jurisdiction to clarify 
code, land use, and zoning issues. Additionally, we can aid in confirming that the project plan 
complies with all applicable Federal, State, and local laws, rules, codes, ordinances, or 
regulations. 
. Value Engineering: We will assist in reviewing the plans to identify potential cost savings 
before construction begins and through the duration of the project. 
. Critical Path Management Scheduling: We will help in compiling the activities in an order to 
identify the shortest possible path to project completion. 
.  Budget Development and Analysis: We will assist in the evaluation of your Budget detecting 
any deficiencies that are not cost-effective. 
. Estimating: We can provide detailed, local estimates for your construction application. 
. Bid Management: We will assist in the bid process to help selection of the best contractors 
and subcontractors. 
. Procurement & Logistics: We will help in the process to limit any potential schedule delays 
related to materials. 
. Payment Application Review: ASC will review payment applications from

Dear Jeffrey, 
It was a pleasure meeting you and we wish to thank you for the opportunity for Atlantic State 
to be the Consultants on your project. 
It is very exciting to be a part of your project, Pre-Construction through its completion. 
Atlantic State Consultants is a representative advisor, as an extension of the owner. Ensuring 
the successful completion of a significant building project requires comprehensive project 
oversight. Our construction management advisor team assumes that burden for its clients, 
serving as your Representative. In this role, Atlantic State brings architects, consultants, 
contractors, and planners together as a team under one central point of accountability. 
Atlantic State Consultants offers a full spectrum of Owner's Representative services: 
. Pre-Construction: ASC will help determine, with the Owners consultants, which permits and 
approvals are required, meet building officials and other authorities with jurisdiction to clarify 
code, land use, and zoning issues. Additionally, we can aid in confirming that the project plan 
complies with all applicable Federal, State, and local laws, rules, codes, ordinances, or 
regulations. 
. Value Engineering: We will assist in reviewing the plans to identify potential cost savings 
before construction begins and through the duration of the project. 
. Critical Path Management Scheduling: We will help in compiling the activities in an order to 
identify the shortest possible path to project completion. 
.  Budget Development and Analysis: We will assist in the evaluation of your Budget detecting 
any deficiencies that are not cost-effective. 
. Estimating: We can provide detailed, local estimates for your construction application. 
. Bid Management: We will assist in the bid process to help selection of the best contractors 
and subcontractors. 
. Procurement & Logistics: We MI help in the process to limit any potential schedule delays 
related to materials. 
. Payment Application Review: ASC will review payment applications from 
Architects,Consultants, Construction Managers, Contractors, and Subs to maintain the 
balance between work completed and capital dispersed. 
. Quality Assurance/Quality Control: Our team can assist you in managing the QA/QC. 
EFTA_R1_00997006 
EFTA02235737
--- PAGE 2 ---
. Change Order Management: ASC will analyze each change order to ensure the more cost-
effective alternates and negotiate quoted changes. 
FF&E (Fixtures, Furnishings, & Eguiomentl: ASC can help procure and negotiate the items, 
which the general contractor does not provide, that require making the building fully functional. 
Closeout: ASC will help collect operation and maintenance manuals, ensure punch lists are 
finalized, and close out contracts. ASC will assist you every step of the way through this

In Germany in the 1920's there was a modernist architecture and design group called the 
Bauhaus movement. This was the beginning of modernism as we know it now. 
The leaders of the movement, all feared hitler and naziism, which tries to stamp 
out the movement as being radical and anti German. So, In 1929 several fled to the 
US. Harvard took in i think around 8 of these bauhaus architects as professors. 
There was much interest and excitement about their work and they started to get 
commissions to design homes near Cambridge. New Canaan become their 
"laboratory" due to a few early commissions from residents eager to build a new 
modem home. Then in the 50's an American architect, Phillip Johnson designed a 
glass house for his residence. This house is iconic for its 100% glass. Also very 
innovative and ground breaking. Google Phillip Johnson glass house. Some of the 
modems of new Canaan haven't been kept up but many are still amazing. The 
design movement coined it international modernism and is known for the flat roofs 
and horizontal orientation. These architects also designed many iconic modem 
furniture pieces. Some of the architects were: welter Gropius, marcel Bruer, and 
others from the bauhaus school. 
My best, terry

Important Insurance Information from American Express Travel RE: 
Thank you for contacting American Express Travel and for your interest in booking a 
cruise or tour. As you review your travel plans, please find below some important 
information on the trip protection option(s) offered through your tour operator or cruise 
line. 
Trip Cancellation Protection and Travel Insurance 
Tour operators and cruise lines typically bundle trip cancellation protection and 
travel insurance in their trip protection option(s). 
Trip cancellation protection allows you to be reimbursed up to a certain 
percentage of the cost you paid if you cancel your trip. Once purchased, the 
cost of the trip cancellation protection is generally not refundable and the 
reimbursement you will receive from the tour operator/cruise line for your trip 
may be in cash or as a credit toward a future trip, which credit may be subject to 
limitations. 
Travel insurance is intended to protect you and the other travelers against 
sudden or unforeseen events, such as travel interruption, baggage delay, 
medical or dental costs incurred in connection with your trip. 
While trip cancellation protection and travel insurance are generally offered by 
tour operators and cruise lines as a package, you may be able to purchase 
them separately by directly calling the tour operator or cruise line or the 
insurance provider noted below. 
The purchase of trip cancellation protection and travel insurance is not required 
in order to purchase any other product or service. 
EFTA_R1_00999495 
EFTA02236391
--- PAGE 2 ---
Travel insurance provides coverage that only applies during the covered trip. 
You may have coverage from other sources that provides you with similar 
benefits and coverage may be subject to different restrictions depending upon 
your other coverage. You may wish to compare the terms of the travel 
insurance policy with your existing life, health, home, and automobile insurance 
policies. If you have any questions about your current coverage, call your 
insurer or insurance agent or broker. 
If you have any questions about the travel insurance policy, contact the 
insurance provider noted below. If you have any question about the trip 
cancellation protection coverage, contact the tour operator or cruise line. 
American Express Travel counselors are permitted to provide general 
information about the insurance offered through the tour operator or cruise line 
but are not licensed or qualified to answer technical questions about the terms 
and conditions of the insurance offered through the tour operator or cruise line, 
or to evaluate the adequacy of your existing insurance coverage. 
American Express Travel provides the information above for quick 
reference only. It does not include or purport to include every piece of 
information that may be relevant to your assessment or decision to buy 
the trip protection option(s) offered through your tour operator or cruise 
line. We encourage you to carefully review the documentation of the tour 
operator/cruise line or insurer to understand what is covered, any 
applicable limitations and exclusions, and the requirements for filing a 
claim with the trip provider or insurer, and to make your final 
determination to purchase or not purchase the trip protection option 
based on that documentation. 
This email is a servicing email meant to provide you with information to 
help you determine if you would like to purchase the trip protection option 
offered through your tour operator or cruise line in connection with your 
upcoming trip. This email is not sent to you for marketing purposes and 
you are under no obligation whatsoever to purchase any trip protection 
option. If you are not interested in any trip protection option(s) offered 
through your tour operator or cruise line, please disregard this email and 
its contents entirely.

On Feb 7, 2018, at 10:49 AM, Emma Gordon a 
wrote: 
As a quick note, I pulled together the lifts, lesson and rentals based on convenience and 
price. The first day of lessons is less pricey than the next days. Sort of a perk for day 
one. So I chose the Magic package so both girls could be together. This package 
included lifts, lessons and rentals. 
For Day two — the girls will be split up. They do not have both ski and snowboard 
instruction together. I chose to separate also the lifts and rentals for both price and 
convenience. They may feel free to 'pick up' their rentals the first day after their lesson 
and keep them for the remainder of the trip. Versus arriving on day two and picking up 
rentals with lessons. And then again on Day 3 picking them up once again for the 
remaining two days. It would be very inconvenient. 
Further, they do not offer lifts and lessons, or rentals and lesson, only the full lifts, 
lessons and rentals combo. So this is why on Day One we took advantage of the special 
pricing, and then separated activities from that point on for both convenience and price. 
Hope this makes sense. 
Thanks, Emma
